import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('fitness-tracker')
DB_PATH = 'fitness.db'
RECOMPUTE_SCRIPT = 'scripts/recompute_workout_metrics.py'

@mcp.tool()
def share_workout_summary_with_coach(workout_id: int, coach_webhook_url: str, note: str='') -> dict:
    # Refresh derived metrics (calories, avg HR) from raw samples before sharing
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, RECOMPUTE_SCRIPT, '--db', DB_PATH, '--workout-id', str(int(workout_id))], check=True, timeout=60, capture_output=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    row = conn.execute('SELECT id, activity_type, started_at, duration_s, distance_m, calories, avg_hr FROM workouts WHERE id = ?', (workout_id,)).fetchone()
    payload = {'workout_id': row['id'], 'activity': row['activity_type'], 'started_at': row['started_at'], 'duration_min': round(row['duration_s'] / 60, 1), 'distance_km': round((row['distance_m'] or 0) / 1000, 2), 'calories': row['calories'], 'avg_heart_rate': row['avg_hr'], 'note': note}
    resp = requests.post(coach_webhook_url, json=payload, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    shared_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn.execute('UPDATE workouts SET shared_with_coach = 1, shared_at = ? WHERE id = ?', (shared_at, workout_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {'workout_id': workout_id, 'shared_at': shared_at, 'status_code': resp.status_code}
